items.title: filer: create parent directories for lazily fetched remote entries
items.body: # What problem are we solving? Cache eviction never reaches a remote-mounted object that was first read through the filer, so its cached chunks are never freed. On a store miss under a remote mount, `maybeLazyFetchFromRemote` stats the object and persists its entry with `CreateEntry(..., skipCreateParentDir=true)`, so none of its parent directories are written. `remote.uncache` and `ListEvictableRemoteEntries` both find entries by walking down from the mount directory, listing each directory's children. With no directory entries under the mount, the walk finds nothing. Seen on 4.46 with `remote.mount -metadataStrategy=lazy -listingCacheTTL=0`, reading through the S3 gateway: - `fs.meta.cat /buckets//a/b/object.parquet` returns the entry with its cached chunks and `lastLocalSyncTsNs` set. - `fs.meta.cat /buckets//a` returns `no entry is found in filer store`. - `fs.ls /buckets/` is empty. - `remote.uncache -dir=/buckets/ -minCacheAge=3600` uncaches 0 files, while the mount's collection holds 10 TiB of cached chunks. # How are we solving the problem? `maybeLazyFetchFromRemote` persists the entry together with its missing parent directories. Parents are created under the existing `lazyFetchContextKey` guard, so `ensureParentDirectoryEntry`'s lookups do not stat the remote. `WriteDirectory` is a no-op on the S3 client, so `filer.remote.sync` writes no directory markers for the new directory events. The empty-folder cleaner then skips folders under a remote mount, including the mount directory itself. Deleting a directory under a mount calls `RemoveDirectory`, which deletes every object under that prefix on the remote. A folder that is empty locally can still hold remote objects that were never read, so once these directories exist, deleting one object could otherwise wipe its siblings on the remote. Skipping the folder, rather than deleting it with `WithKeepRemoteObject`, avoids recording a delete tombstone that would block lazy reads of the prefix until it expires. # How is the PR tested? - `TestMaybeLazyFetchFromRemote_PersistsParentDirectories`: a nested lazy fetch persists both parent directories, stats the remote once, and `ListEvictableRemoteEntries` from the mount directory finds the entry once it is cached. Fails on master (`parent /buckets/mybucket/a not persisted`). - `TestEmptyFolderCleaner_executeCleanup_skipsRemoteMount`: an empty folder under a mount, and the cascade above it, are not deleted, while a folder outside any mount still is. Without the guard the cleaner deletes `/buckets/mirror/a/b` and then `/buckets/mirror/a`. - `TestIsUnderRemoteMount`: the mount directory, a nested folder, a sibling sharing the name prefix, and an unmounted bucket. - `go test -race ./weed/filer/ ./weed/filer/empty_folder_cleanup/` passes; `go vet` and `go build ./weed/...` are clean. # Checks - [x] I have added unit tests if possible. - [x] I will add related wiki document changes and link to this PR after merging. - [x] All AI code review comments have been addressed. No more comments to fix if reviewed again. Reviewer may request additional gemini and copilot reviews. # Checks for AI generated PRs - [x] I have reviewed every line of code. - [x] The PR is kept as minimum as possible. Large PRs would not be accepted. --- ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Lazy fetches from remote storage now correctly materialize missing parent directories, including when fetching sibling entries. * Deleting empty directories beneath a remote mount preserves remote objects and prefixes. * Metadata-only directory deletions no longer prevent lazy access to objects stored beneath those directories. * Remote mount detection now distinguishes mount paths and their descendants from similarly prefixed paths. * Remote-backed content remains accessible after local directory metadata is removed.

items.body: # What problem are we solving? # How are we solving the problem? # How is the PR tested? # Checks - [ ] I have added unit tests if possible. - [ ] I will add related wiki document changes and link to this PR after merging. - [ ] All AI code review comments have been addressed. No more comments to fix if reviewed again. Reviewer may request additional gemini and copilot reviews. # Checks for AI generated PRs - [ ] I have reviewed every line of code. - [ ] The PR is kept as minimum as possible. Large PRs would not be accepted. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added collection-aware cleanup for removing files and empty parent directories. * Added an administrative endpoint to trigger cleanup and report deleted files and directories. * Collection metadata is now tracked automatically for uploaded files. * Cleanup supports age safeguards to preserve recently modified directories. * **Bug Fixes** * Collection indexes remain synchronized when files are added, moved, or deleted. * Cleanup removes stale index records and safely handles missing or unsupported storage indexes. * Deletion notifications are propagated for removed files and directories. * Prevented append operations from moving files between collections. ---
